static.about.cc0:
Structured data is released under CC0; attribution via links back is
		encouraged but not required. Sign in with Toolhub — no separate Evolved account
		or password is needed.
static.about.prototypeNote: This is a companion interface for Toolhub: it reads live catalog data from the public API, publishes official writes through Toolhub OAuth when you sign in, and keeps Evolved-only additions in its local overlay database.

static.codeOfConduct.cocLink: Code of Conduct for Wikimedia technical spaces
static.codeOfConduct.expected:
Be welcoming and helpful, especially to newcomers. Harassment and other
		inappropriate behaviour are unacceptable in all public and private Wikimedia
		technical spaces.
static.codeOfConduct.quote:
Technical skills and community status make no difference to the right
		to be respected and the obligation to respect others.
static.codeOfConduct.title: Code of Conduct
static.community.intro:
Toolhub is developed in the open under Wikimedia Cloud Services. Everyone is
		welcome to take part — reporting bugs, suggesting tools, translating, or writing
		code.

static.contribute.intro:
Toolhub is free and open source, built by the community
		under Wikimedia Cloud Services. Here is everything you need to report a problem,
		translate, or contribute code — pick a starting point.

static.contribute.reportBugDesc: Open a task on the #toolhub Phabricator board.

static.help.buildListBody:
Group useful tools into a list and share it — great for onboarding new editors
		or running an event.
static.help.intro:
New to Toolhub? Here is the quickest path to finding and sharing tools. Sign
		in with Toolhub to save favourites, build lists, and publish permitted edits —
		no separate Evolved account is needed.

static.rss.intro:
Follow changes to the catalog without checking back. Toolhub publishes Atom/RSS
		feeds for activity such as recently added and recently updated tools, and for the
		history of individual tools and lists.

static.rulesOfEngagement.summary: In short: Toolhub remains the source of truth for catalog data; Evolved publishes through Toolhub when signed in and keeps local overlay data for drafts, fallback, and features Toolhub does not expose.
static.rulesOfEngagement.title: Rules of Engagement

static.signIn.readOnlyNote: Official writes still follow Toolhub's permissions. Evolved keeps supported rejected writes locally as drafts or overlays so you can revise them.

toolforms.fieldAnnoToolTypeHint: Community classification used for discovery when core metadata is sparse.
toolforms.fieldAudiencesHint: User groups this tool serves, such as editors, admins, researchers, or developers.
toolforms.fieldDescriptionHint: One or two useful sentences: what it does, who it helps, and when to use it.
toolforms.fieldIconHint: Optional Commons-hosted image URL for visual identification.
toolforms.fieldKeywordsHint: Search terms people may try; avoid repeating only the title.
toolforms.fieldLangsHint: BCP-47 / wiki language codes; saved values refresh the tool page immediately in this demo.
toolforms.fieldLicenseHint: Use an SPDX identifier when known; leave blank if the license is unknown.
toolforms.fieldNameHint: Stable lowercase id used in Toolhub URLs; it cannot be changed later.
toolforms.fieldRepositoryHint: Optional public repository where contributors can inspect or patch the code.
toolforms.fieldTasksHint: Workflows this tool supports, such as editing, patrolling, importing, or analysis.
toolforms.fieldTitleHint: Short public name shown in search results and tool pages.
toolforms.fieldToolinfoJsonHint: Paste one tool object or an array; successful entries appear below in Your tools.
toolforms.fieldToolinfoUrlHint: Full public URL the crawler should re-read, usually ending in toolinfo.json.
toolforms.fieldToolTypeHint: Choose the closest match; community annotations can refine discovery later.
toolforms.fieldUrlHint: Primary place people launch the tool or read its documentation.
toolforms.fieldWikisHint: Use wiki database names such as enwiki or commonswiki, or * for all wikis.
toolforms.ingestIntroTail: URL, or paste/ingest toolinfo to add records.
